name: Sakuragi Rena
source:
A creative, romantic girl who prefers handwritten letters to cellphone text messages, Rena wishes her life was more like a fairy tale. At times, her older brother [url=http://vndb.org/c2036]Hiroshi[/url] is overprotective of her exceptional sensitivity.
